title: Cadmies Canonical 15 Domain Taxonomy
definition: A classification system dividing CADMIES concepts into 15 core domains.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A way to categorize all CADMIES concepts into 15 main categories such as physics, philosophy, and biology.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A system organizing CADMIES concepts into 15 core domains, providing a means to explore relationships between concepts across different areas.
difficulty_levels.expert: A taxonomy organizing CADMIES concepts into 15 core domains, reflecting the interdisciplinary nature of the system and enabling researchers to study and explore connections between concepts.

extra_fields.insight: The taxonomy provides a structured framework for understanding and navigating the vast array of concepts within CADMIES.
